subject.title: fix(anthropic): restrict OAuth callback host to loopback addresses and derive redirect URI

question: Should OpenClaw accept loopback-only Anthropic OAuth callback hosts, including failing closed for non-loopback OPENCLAW_OAUTH_CALLBACK_HOST values and deriving the redirect URI from the validated host?
rationale: The code repair is narrow and matches the sibling OAuth pattern, but it changes a currently accepted env-controlled auth path and the linked security report depends on an operator-controlled environment premise that maintainers must frame under SECURITY.md.

options.title: Accept Loopback-Only Anthropic OAuth
options.body: Approve the compatibility break for non-loopback callback hosts because arbitrary remote callback hosts are not a supported local CLI OAuth contract.

options.title: Require Live Provider Exchange Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live Anthropic token-exchange proof before accepting provider-side redirect registration risk for every allowed loopback spelling.

options.title: Pause For Anthropic OAuth Direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want to remove or redesign the direct Anthropic OAuth helper instead of hardening it in place.

recommendation.title: Accept Loopback-Only Anthropic OAuth
recommendation.body: Approve the compatibility break for non-loopback callback hosts because arbitrary remote callback hosts are not a supported local CLI OAuth contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned on the live PR and has the strongest current-main and Anthropic auth-choice history signal for this decision.
